stem: Which sentence best shows the author of the selection’s attitude toward the writing of The Silmarillion?

options.label: A
options.text: The Silmarillion can be thought of as a prequel to The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings.

options.label: B
options.text: But the story of how The Silmarillion was created may be just as interesting as the story told on its pages.

options.label: C
options.text: Kay’s work on The Silmarillion undoubtedly provided training and valuable experience on his journey to become an author.

options.label: D
options.text: The Silmarillion was published in 1977 to mixed reviews.
